Updates an existing encounter by a unique case ID. All existing fields on the encounter will be overwritten based on fields/values provided in the request body - for sent fields, values will be maintained or updated. For fields not included in the call, values will be cleared. For Role Assignments, existing assignments will not be changed/removed if that encounterRoleKey is not included in the call.
